name: Hida Tobira
source:
A slightly shady man who always wears black. He works as a consultant at a company called Hida Consulting.
He apparently has a wife named  [url=/c7873]Tama[/url] ,but her real name is unknown. He seems to have known Shin for a long time, and Shin calls him Toby.
[translated from digital setting materials]
